design: ONE long-lived process (the gateway). No supervisor, no watchdog, no front-fleet, no per-front ports. Backends are dispatch descriptors: kind=module (imported in-process) or kind=binary (spawned per invocation, reaped on return). Availability is computed lazily from what is actually importable/on PATH - never a static flag that can drift.

catalogs.policy: availability = lazily computed (module importable / binary on PATH / rpc reachable / mcp-stdio worker spawn+initialize / mcp-http initialize handshake). An unavailable backend stays discoverable and harness_invoke returns its install note. No raw fallback, no silent degradation.
